# Teaching.

[Alliance Manchester Business School.](https://www.alliancembs.manchester.ac.uk/) United Kingdom. 2010 – current. **Courses taught (6):** Individual Projects 2010 – 2011 and 2014–2015. Research Methods 2011 – 2012. Group Project 2013 – 2014. Global MBA Project 2014–2015 and 2015–2016. Live Business Project 2018 GMBA. MSc Financial Management programme 2023, 2024, 2025.

[Universidad de Monterrey UDEM.](https://www.udem.edu.mx/en) México. 2015. **Courses taught (1):** Financial Project Evaluation.

[University of Liverpool, Management School.](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/management/) United Kingdom. 2015. **Courses taught (1):** Economics of Oil, Gas & Energy.

[Alliance Manchester Business School,](https://www.alliancembs.manchester.ac.uk/) Finance PhD. United Kingdom. 2011 – 2012. **Courses taught (1):** Three sessions of Advanced Finance Research Seminar I.

[Tecnológico de Monterrey.](https://tec.mx/es) México. 2005 – 2010. **Courses taught (5):** Fundamentals of Managerial Finance (2008); Managerial Economics (2009); Economics for Decision Taking (2010); Economic Environment (2009); Economics of the Firm (2005).

## Teaching: Executive training.

**Courses taught (4):** Finance for non-financiers (online and face-to-face formats 2012 – 2017, 2019); Mexican fiscal reform 2014; entrepreneurial seminar 2014; corporate training in finance for enterprises such as [Kimberly-Clark](https://www.kimberly-clark.com.mx/) (2013), [Stoneridge](https://www.stoneridge.com/) (2013), [Magna](https://www.magna.com/es) (2014, 2017), [COPARMEX](https://coparmex.org.mx/) (2014), [Linamar](https://www.linamar.com/es/) (2015, 10 groups), [Ternium](https://mx.ternium.com/es) (2021).
